description: How freight, heavy equipment and crews reach a Texas address or coordinate, from federal public data: the nearest major highway (interstate, freeway or principal arterial) and nearest interstate with traffic (AADT, average daily vehicles) and truck counts from FHWA HPMS 2024; the nearest active rail line with owner, subdivision and trackage rights and the nearest rail yard (FRA North American Rail Network); the nearest transload site with the modes it connects (US Army Corps ERDC), rail intermodal or Ro-Ro terminal, and port (BTS); and the nearest public-use airport and nearest public airport with a 5,000 ft runway (FAA NASR), with drive miles and minutes by road where the router answers. Straight-line miles otherwise. Free shows what is nearby and how far; Pro adds names, owners, traffic and truck counts, runway length and drive times.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.
